label: Lantas 2.0.0 development build
changes: Workspace coding now runs on OpenCode's engine: Lantas starts a bundled `opencode serve` for each project folder, so threads use its sessions, tools, file edits and terminal commands — the same engine OpenWork runs.
One engine session per workspace chat, so follow-up turns keep their context. Workspace threads from before 2.0.0 are handed to the engine with a compact transcript the first time they are opened.
Approvals still come through Lantas: Ask mode shows the existing approval sheet for commands and edits (with the diff), while Auto mode answers immediately.
Chat and Browser keep Lantas's own loop, including screen control, page tools and the Code/Browser workspace tabs.
